subject: Request: Subprocessor disclosure & SIG/CAIQ evidence for Medlytic POC
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@medlytic.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medlytic.com
Date: 2025-08-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Subprocessor list + SIG/CAIQ for POC compliance review

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked promising and the team (security + procurement) wants to move the POC forward. Before we spin up the dataset and tests, our InfoSec team needs the following from Redwood: 

- Current subprocessor inventory (including role, region, and purpose)
- SOC 2 attestation or summary evidence
- Completed SIG Lite or CAIQ (either is fine for the initial review)
- Any third-party risk assessments you have for major infra providers

Can you share these materials or point me to a secure folder? We have a one-week window to complete our initial review for the POC kickoff on Aug 12. If you can provide at least the subprocessor list + SOC2 summary by EOD Aug 3, that would be very helpful.

Also, let me know if you need an NDA or a DPA in place before we exchange artifacts.

Best,
Claire
Claire O'Neill
Head of Security Operations
Medlytic

[attachment: request_checklist.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@medlytic.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor list + SIG/CAIQ for POC compliance review

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marcus (Head of Security) and Stephanie (Solutions) so you have direct contacts for artifacts and any PO/contract questions.

Quick plan:
- Attached: redwood_subprocessors_2025.csv (exported inventory with roles & regions)
- Marcus will share SOC2 summary + SIG responses tomorrow AM
- We have a CAIQ draft in progress; Marcus will indicate ETA (should be by Aug 4)

Proposed mutual actions (to keep both teams aligned):
1) We provide SOC2 summary + subprocessor CSV by EOD Aug 3
2) Medlytic reviews artifacts and flags any follow-up items by Aug 6
3) Joint call Aug 7 (30 min) to close outstanding questions before POC kickoff

Let me know if you'd prefer a different timeline. Attaching the CSV now — it includes primary subprocessors and a short note on purpose.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0193
[attachment: redwood_subprocessors_2025.csv]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-03T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor list + SIG/CAIQ for POC compliance review

Claire — filing this in the thread so it's easy to trace later. Attaching the SOC2 summary (redwood SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf) and our completed SIG Lite spreadsheet (SIG-responses-2025.xlsx). A few notes and context below.

Attachment notes:
- SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf: high-level scope, auditor name, and key control families. Full attestation available under NDA; we can initiate a secure transfer if Medlytic needs the full report.
- SIG-responses-2025.xlsx: completed by security/ops; flagged items in the last column where we provide compensating controls.
- redwood_subprocessors_2025.csv: includes subprocessors, purpose, hosting region, and data access level.

CAIQ status: we have a draft CAIQ that covers our control baseline, but a couple of vendor-specific questions require redaction/clarification from a hardware partner. Estimated delivery for a redacted CAIQ: COB Aug 4. If you need an unredacted CAIQ, we require an NDA + IP protection agreement; happy to discuss.

Third-party risk summaries: for our major infra providers (AWS, GCP partners) we provide vendor risk summaries on request — I can either attach short PDFs or share a secure folder with those docs.

Security contact and disclosures: for any procurement evidence requests or penetration-test summaries, please send the specific checklist items and we will prioritize.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Head of Security & Reliability, Redwood Inference
[attachment: SOC2-Summary-2024.pdf]
[attachment: SIG-responses-2025.xlsx]
[attachment: CAIQ-draft-answers.docx]

From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@medlytic.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-04T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor list + SIG/CAIQ for POC compliance review

Marcus / Rishi — received, and thanks for the fast turnaround. I've shared the artifacts with our security reviewers and they appreciate the level of detail in the SIG sheet. A couple of items noted by our team: 

- We need the SOC2 auditor name & report period in the summary (I see high-level details but not those fields). Can you confirm?
- For subprocessors that have access to customer data, please confirm whether access is encrypted in transit and at rest (you can add a Y/N column to the CSV).
- Once the CAIQ draft is finalized, please upload to a secure drive and share the link (our procurement requires a link rather than attachments).

Also, Medlytic legal will request a DPA with the standard security addendum before we move data into the POC environment. I can share their template — do you have a preferred counterparty contact?

Happy to take the Aug 7 joint call. Can Rishi propose 30 minutes (10–10:30a PT) and include dial-in details?

Thanks,
Claire
Head of Security Operations, Medlytic

[inline: Claire forwarded the request checklist to internal reviewers]
